newsitem.title: UK: BoE revises up January s/a M4 to 10.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: BoE revises up January s/a M4 to 10.0 percent.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Thursday M4 money supply growth rose a revised seasonally adjusted 10.0 percent year-on-year in January.
It was last reported at 9.8 percent.

The Bank also said gilt repos included in M4 rose by 0.9 billion stg to 10.9 billion in February and reverses repos included in sterling lending to the M4 private sector rose by 3.0 billion stg to 19.5 billion.
Net purchases of gilts by the M4 private sector were 1.7 billion stg, not seasonally adjusted, in February.
